bullets.title: AVGO: Crowded long into earnings; buyside 5% below consensus on F28 AI revenue
bullets.body: AVGO reports Sept 2 with Street at $3.22 EPS and $29.24B revenue. JPM and MS both flag crowded-but-lightening long positioning; key risk is GOOGL/MediaTek share loss on custom ASIC projects, with buyside AI revenue estimates 5% below consensus for F28. Bulls point to TPU v8i inflection, Tomahawk 6 sold out, and a backlog potentially >$150B with room for a guide raise. MS sees potential upside to ~$120B in 2027 AI revenue. UBS flags AVGO as heavily crowded per prime brokerage data.

bullets.title: DELL: Reporting tonight; UBS raises AI server forecast to $66.9B for F27
bullets.body: DELL reports after close with $4.91 EPS and $44.89B revenue consensus. UBS raised F'27 AI server revenue forecast to $66.9B (from $60.6B), modeling $177.8B revenue vs. consensus $174.8B. Deutsche Bank initiates at Hold with $480 PT (5% upside). JPM previews modest expectations, with GPU/CPU server strength in neoclouds as the thesis.

bullets.title: MDB: Atlas must accelerate >30% Y/Y to satisfy buyside; stock stretched at $450
bullets.body: MDB reports tonight with $1.62 EPS and $735M revenue consensus. JPM and Jefferies flag stretched long positioning with buyside requiring Atlas growth above +30% Y/Y (vs. +26% guidance). Q3 guidance needs +27% Y/Y Atlas guide and ~$765-770M revenue. UBS maintains Neutral at $460 PT, seeing no material AI-driven acceleration yet. Wolfe has a $545 PT on alpha list.

bullets.title: CIEN: Expect beat + early FY27 +30% guide; attractive post -35% pullback
bullets.body: CIEN reports Thursday pre-market with $1.73 EPS consensus. JPM expects a 3c EPS beat ($1.76) and small revenue beat; early FY27 guidance of +30% revenue growth could set up C28 EPS of ~$20 at an attractive valuation following the stock's -35% pullback. Wolfe lists CIEN on its alpha list with a $660 PT (+74%).

bullets.title: CRDO: Expect 3.6% revenue beat and 8c EPS upside; SpaceX wildcard emerging
bullets.body: CRDO reports tonight. JPM expects revenue beat of 3.6% and EPS beat of 8c, with key catalysts being $700M+ optical revenue guidance and AEC upside. Jefferies flags an ALAB-type risk if numbers viewed as 'just enough.' SpaceX exposure is an emerging wildcard with 2GW+ scaling to 5-10GW CY27 presenting a multi-year revenue opportunity.

bullets.title: NVDA: $35B Anthropic/Lambda deal + $3.5B MediaTek investment reinforce AI cycle
bullets.body: Anthropic signed a $35B cloud-computing deal with Nvidia-backed Lambda; NVDA will supply chips and hold the Texas data center lease. Separately, NVDA is investing $3.5B in MediaTek via convertible bonds for custom AI chips and NVLink Fusion integration. NVDA also committed $1.5B equity purchase in SB Energy IPO. Hedgeye flags NVDA as Bullish trend; Wolfe PT $275 (+26%).

bullets.title: META: Morgan Stanley upgrades to OW, $775 PT on $18B lawsuit settlement clearing overhang
bullets.body: MS upgrades META to Overweight from Equal-weight with a $775 PT. The $18B mental health lawsuit settlement (~$10B accrued in 3Q) clears regulatory overhang and could unlock a pipeline of product innovation (MetaAI, agentic ads, subscriptions) worth $10+ EPS. META trades at 16x forward EPS, ~25% below long-term average. Hedgeye flags META as Bearish trend.

bullets.title: HOOD: Morgan Stanley upgrades to OW, $150 PT on platform expansion and 28% EPS CAGR
bullets.body: MS upgrades HOOD to Overweight from Equal-weight with a $150 PT, citing 23% revenue CAGR to $8.0B through 2028 driven by wallet consolidation, active trader growth, prediction markets, and Rothera platform. Forecast 28% EPS CAGR to $3.28 in 2028 from $1.99 in 2026, with 53% EBITDA margins by 2028. HOOD was up +2% in pre-market.

bullets.title: TEAM: Citi raises PT to $225 from $170 on AI 'winner' status shift
bullets.body: Citi raises TEAM PT to $225 (from $170) with exit multiples of 8x EV/S and 22x EV/FCF on CY29E. The upgrade is driven by stable sentiment post-earnings, better CFO, enterprise penetration, and AI traction showing the stock has shifted from 'AI-safe' to 'AI-winner.' Stock has 2x'd since 8/6 results.

bullets.title: PANW: Needs material beat (+$70-100M above NGS ARR guidance) to sustain 100%+ YTD rally
bullets.body: PANW reports tonight after +100% YTD gain. JPM sets the bar at Net New NGS ARR of $860-890M (vs. Street ~$790M), Q1'27 at $300-325M, and FY'27 guidance ~$2.0-2.1B. Jefferies flags FY'27 NGS ARR must exceed $11B to satisfy market. Crowded long positioning raises the stakes for a 'Mythic Quarter.'

bullets.title: AMZN: Citi reiterates Buy/$350 PT; FTC $20B ad lawsuit seen as manageable
bullets.body: FTC and 22 states allege Amazon overcharged ~1.2M advertisers by $20B+ via undisclosed reserve-pricing since 2019. Citi reiterates Buy at $350 PT (31.5x 2027E P/E), noting Amazon's Sponsored Products CPCs were flat inflation-adjusted 2019-2024 while conversion rates rose 24%+. 2Q Ads revenue accelerated +26% Y/Y to $19.8B; AWS AI tailwinds with 2M+ NVDA GPUs deploying 2027-28.

bullets.title: Deutsche Bank initiates networking/optical sector: ANET, COHR, CSCO, HPE, LITE buy; DELL hold
bullets.body: Deutsche Bank's Gianmarco Conti initiates: ANET Buy/$220 PT (12% upside), COHR Buy/$400 PT (44%), CSCO Buy/$135 PT (22%), HPE Buy/$62 PT (19%), LITE Buy/$1,200 PT (31%), DELL Hold/$480 PT (5%). Rosenblatt also initiates ANET at Buy/$220 and CSCO at Buy/$135.

bullets.title: Rosenblatt initiates internet/travel: ABNB, BKNG, DASH, UBER buy; CART, EXPE neutral
bullets.body: Scott Devitt at Rosenblatt initiates: ABNB Buy/$220 (20% upside), BKNG Buy/$245 (23%), DASH Buy/$270 (17%), UBER Buy/$100 (32%). CART initiated Neutral/$55 (9% upside) — CART +1.3% in pre-market. EXPE neutral/$360 (14%), LYV neutral/$19 (12%).

bullets.title: ADBE: Citi raises PT to $301 from $228 but stays Neutral; FY27 ARR concerns persist
bullets.body: Citi raises ADBE PT to $301 on broad software multiple expansion (10.4x FY28E EV/FCF) but keeps Neutral. Q3 is beatable with potential beat/raise after ~$500M organic FY26 ARR guidance cut. Creative Cloud pressure from pricing, downsells, and seat compression expected to extend into FY27; below-Street FY27 total ARR growth forecast of ~6.9%.

bullets.title: PINS: CFO departure raises guidance confidence questions ahead of Communacopia
bullets.body: PINS CFO Julia Brau Donnelly is departing to become CFO at Sierra (private AI company, $15B+ valuation), which JPM suggests may be pursuing a near-term IPO. The 8-K did not explicitly reaffirm quarterly guidance, raising questions; management to address at Communacopia Conference.

bullets.title: CHTR: CFO Fischer departing Oct 15 to join Blackstone-Google AI infrastructure JV
bullets.body: Charter CFO Jessica Fischer announced departure effective October 15; Kevin Howard named interim CFO. Fischer is joining a newly formed Blackstone-Google AI infrastructure joint venture. CHTR was down 1.7% in pre-market on the news.

bullets.title: Software sector: Citi 2H26 playbook favors SNOW, MDB, ORCL, FIG, TEAM on AI acceleration
bullets.body: Citi notes software has bounced 47% since April lows on positioning/narrative, not fundamentals. Short interest as % of float surpassed 2016 and 2008 peaks. Fewer than 50% of software companies expected to accelerate growth. Citi favors AI infrastructure plays and M&A/takeout optionality names: top ideas APPN, BOX, DDOG, DT, FIG, MDB, NAVN, ORCL, SNOW, TEAM.

bullets.title: EQIX, DLR: Mizuho bullish despite data center NIMBYism; EQIX $1,275 PT, DLR $223 PT
bullets.body: Mizuho maintains Outperform on EQIX ($1,275 PT, 22% upside) and DLR ($223 PT, 20% upside) despite spreading state-level NIMBYism (NY moratorium, 9 states with pending moratoriums, 20+ with restrictive legislation). Under-construction projects are already entitled with grid connections; land banks face some risk. Strong AI compute demand supports valuations.

bullets.title: Semiconductors weak in pre-market: MRVL -3.4%, INTC -2.8%, AAOI -3.7% on broad sector pressure
bullets.body: Chip names sliding in pre-market amid global bond yield spike and geopolitical risk: MRVL -3.4%, INTC -2.8%, AAOI -3.7%, with CoreWeave (CRWV) -3.1% and NBIS -2.9%. UBS raises 2027/28 WFE forecasts to $225B/$275B but flags CXMT HBM3E production pressuring memory stocks. HBM demand growing 200%+ YoY vs. supply ~20%.

bullets.title: TTD: Launches Kokai Zuma with agentic AI features including Koa Assistant
bullets.body: The Trade Desk launched Kokai Zuma with improved navigation, agentic AI, automated audience creation, and the Koa Assistant for measurement/reporting features. KeyBanc flagged the update as a meaningful platform enhancement.
